title: Picou's clarinet pupils: Nelson, Darensbourg, Nicholas, Hall, Noone
summary: Asked about pupils, Picou names Louis Nelson, Joe Darensbourg, Albert Nicholas, Edmond Hall and Jimmie Noone.
